name: following: the acceleration behind a leader, swept over the speed
why: This game's following law is the improved IDM (Treiber and Kesting, Traffic Flow Dynamics, 2013, 11.3.7: no braking when the gap is above the desired one, a free road branch), the reference's the plain IDM with a release fade: their values differ by design wherever the follower is below its desired gap; the pair keeps that difference the only one
